notes:
Based on what I found on Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's own site — the only gymnastics operator in town — here's what's real for a toddler this fall:

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Toddler Program (18 months - 3 years), Preschool and Kinderfun",
      "age_fit": "18 months - 3 years",
      "when": "Fall Session: Sept 10 - Dec 16",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool Drop-In",
      "age_fit": "under 4 (Pre-school age children only)",
      "when": "Runs during the school year, Oct 9 to June 26, no drop-in during March Break or statutory holidays",
      "price": "$15, one parent / up to 4 children",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes on what I saw:
- The 18-month-to-3-year class: 
this program is for the toddler who loves to be on the move, involves parent participation, and is led by a coach through a structured warm-up, games, music, and circuits on all gymnastic events
, running 
Fall Session: Sept 10 - Dec 16
. The page didn't post a price for this specific class.
- The Preschool Drop-In: 
parents bring their busy preschool aged child (under 4) to explore gymnastics equipment — bouncing on the trampoline, swinging on the bars, tumbling — with parents staying with their child, no experience necessary
, and it costs 
$15, one parent/up to 4 children
, with 
no pre-registration necessary, payment made at the door
. It 
runs October 9 till June 26, 2026, with no drop-in outside of these dates
.

Neither page posted a specific day/time for these two classes, so it's worth calling 905-877-4330 to confirm the schedule slot before showing up.
